description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

MyTelemedicine is hiring a Junior to Mid-Level Mobile Developer to build, maintain, and improve mobile applications, primarily for Android. The role also contributes to iOS development as needed and collaborates with designers, QA engineers, and backend developers in an onsite engineering team.
Mobile Developer developing Android apps, supporting iOS features, and integrating REST APIs and mobile services

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain mobile applications, with Android as the primary platform
• Build and maintain features from requirements through testing and production release
• Contribute to iOS features, enhancements, and bug fixes as needed
• Work closely with designers, QA engineers, and backend developers
• Integrate REST APIs, third-party services, analytics, authentication, push notifications, and other mobile services
• Troubleshoot and resolve application bugs, crashes, and performance issues
• Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards
• Help improve application performance, reliability, security, and user experience
• Participate in technical planning, feature estimation, and architecture discussions
• Learn and adopt new mobile technologies and development practices

Requirements:
• **1–4 years of professional software or mobile development experience**, including internships or significant project experience
• Experience developing **Android applications**
• Experience with **Kotlin** and the Android SDK
• Familiarity with modern Android development, including Jetpack and/or Jetpack Compose
• Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, asynchronous programming, and mobile application architecture
• Some professional or project-based experience with **iOS development using Swift**
• Familiarity with Git and standard software development workflows
• Understanding of software testing and debugging practices
• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn
• Good communication and collaboration skills
• The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in mobile development, writes clean and maintainable code, is comfortable learning new technologies, and works well in a collaborative, onsite environment
• We're looking for someone who is **strongly interested in Android development and capable of contributing to iOS**
• For a junior candidate, we're looking for a solid technical foundation, strong problem-solving skills, and the desire to grow into a well-rounded mobile engineer
• For a mid-level candidate, we're looking for someone who can take greater ownership of features, troubleshoot problems independently, and contribute to technical decisions and code quality
• Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is **curious, collaborative, dependable, and excited about building great mobile applications.**

Preferred:
• Experience with **SwiftUI** and modern iOS development
• Experience with **Jetpack Compose**
• Experience with Firebase or similar mobile services
• Experience with push notifications, deep linking, analytics, and crash reporting
• Familiarity with mobile CI/CD tools and automated testing
• Experience publishing or maintaining applications through the Google Play Store or Apple App Store
• Experience working with Agile/Scrum development practices
